cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I tell you who won the chair's election, Jo or Nina—which did you want? Give your own answer, the way I taught you in debate practice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An observation before a guess; you're improving. Now leave my face out of it. Jo or Nina?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write yours down before I answer, then. You used to change every argument when you saw my notes. Keep this one covered until I've told you mine.

reason: Connect the specific tuition to A present pursuit. Make B correction or practical objection change A actual demand, and replace detached final explanations with an action or answer A needs.
